Class ColorSetting

dev.px.core.setting.impl.ColorSetting
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named
public final class ColorSetting extends Setting<Color>
A colour, rendered as a picker.

Supports two dynamic modes that most clients end up reimplementing per module: a rainbow cycle and a sync to the active Theme. resolve() applies whichever is active, so call sites just draw with the result and never branch on the mode.
